inputs.mid_filings_read: 945 Part 565 filings (VW Group incl. Audi 287+59, BMW/MINI 263, Mercedes/Daimler 162, Volvo Car 87, Porsche 84, Land Rover/JLR 268 (LR-relevant subset), Saab 16, FHI 3), filed up to 2021; scanned ones OCR'd

answer.Volkswagen: PARTLY ENCODED. Position 4 ('Series') carries the transmission for some lines from MY2006: Rabbit (A/C manual, B/D automatic, 2006-2009), new GTI (E/G manual, F/H automatic, 2006-2010), Eos (A/C manual, B/D/F automatic, 2007-2010), Passat B6 (2006-2008 sedan and wagon, e.g. G/U/K/H/Y/N/W/S manual), CC (N manual, M/H automatic, 2009-2010), Golf (A/C 5MT, M/N 6MT, B/D automatic, 2010); VW keeps this for Golf/GTI in later breakdowns. NOT ENCODED before MY2006 (MY2004-2005 breakdowns: position 4 is a trim such as GL/GLS/GLX) and NOT ENCODED for Jetta, Jetta SportWagen, GLI, New Beetle, Passat NMS (A/B/C = S/SE/SEL), Routan, Touareg, Tiguan in any breakdown read.
answer.Audi: NOT ENCODED for MY2005-2009 (Audi VIN breakdowns: position 4 series, 5 engine, 6 restraint, 7-8 model; no transmission column). From the MY2010 breakdown on, the position 4 series table carries a 'Trans' column (A/M) for some series (e.g. MY2018 A4 quattro Premium D = automatic, N = manual). Not ruled here: no lot car without transmission info falls in a manual code of those years.
answer.BMW: ENCODED BY MODEL CODE in two eras. MY1981-1990 (E21/E23/E24/E28/E30/E32/E34): BMW of North America's serial-number manual gives the automatic its own AG code (VIN positions 4-7), e.g. 325i/4 AD13 vs 325i A/4 AD23, 525i HC13 vs HC23. E39 5 Series MY1999-2003: 525i DT3x / 525iA DT4x, 530i DT5x / DT6x, 540i DN5x / DN6x, 525iT DS3x / DS4x (BMW MY2003 DMV package). NOT ENCODED for E46 3 Series (1999-2006), E53 X5, E83 X3, Z3/Z4, E60/E90 and later (one code covers both transmissions). E36 (1992-1999), E34 1991-1995, E31, 528i 1997-2000 codes come in pairs, but no BMW document in MID names which is the automatic.
answer.MINI: NOT ENCODED: BMW's MY2003 table gives Cooper (RC33) and Cooper S (RE33) one type code each for both transmissions, and later type codes (MF33/MF73, SU3C/SV3C, ZB3C/ZC3C ...) likewise. Manual-only by model: Cooper S RE33 MY2003-2004 (BMW lists no automatic serial range; EPA Manual 6-spd only; automatic from MY2005), MY2002 candidate (no EPA row). John Cooper Works MY2009 (MF93 Hardtop, MM93 Clubman) and MY2012 (SV9C, ZG9C, ZP9C, SX5C) per BMW's MINI decipherment tables, manual-only per EPA (first automatic JCW rows are MY2013).
answer.Mercedes-Benz: NOT ENCODED in any filing read (MY1980s-2021). Positions 4-6/4-7 are the model (e.g. WDD WF4J = C300 sedan); the MY2016+ tables give an automatic gear count in the engine description. US manuals (190E 2.3/2.6, C230/C320 Sport, SLK, C300 Sport, SLK250) share their model code with automatics. vPIC's 'manual' for every 1999-2000 SLK230 is a vPIC default (uniformCell), not VIN evidence.
answer.Volvo: NOT ENCODED. MY1984-1993: 4 series, 5 restraint, 6-7 engine, 8 body. MY1994-2003 filings annotate engine-version + emissions combinations as Man. Only / Auto Only / both; the only US manual-only combination is the 850 B5254S with emissions code 0 (MY1994-1995, plus Canada-only B5234T/B5234T5 code 0). MY2004 on: engine versions annotated 'Automatic Only' or 'Automatic/Manual', no manual-only version.
answer.Saab: ENCODED. Position 7 'Gearbox' in every Saab filing in MID: MY1988-2001 5 = 5-speed manual, 6 = 3-speed automatic (900, to MY1994), 8 = 4-speed automatic; MY2010-2012 M/N = 6-speed manual, A/B = 6-speed automatic, C = 5-speed automatic (MY2010-2011). MID has no Saab filing for MY2002-2009 (vPIC decodes these, codes 5/6/7 manual). Not Saab VINs: 9-7X (GM, 5S3, automatic only) and 9-2X (Subaru, JF4; no filing for JF4).
answer.Porsche: NOT ENCODED in any filing read (MY1985-2021: line, body type, restraint system, engine; Cayenne lists a GVWR per transmission but no VIN code).
answer.Land Rover: ENCODED MY1993-1998: position 8 'Transmission Type' 4 = 4-speed automatic, 8 = 5-speed manual. MY1999 on: the position lists automatics only (4; Freelander 2 = 5-speed automatic), and every lot car with a VIN already has a vPIC transmission.

vin_scheme.Saab: YS3: 4 car line, 5 model series/restraint, 6 body, 7 GEARBOX, 8 engine, 10 year, 11 assembly line.
vin_scheme.Land Rover: SAL (1993-1998): 4-5 model/line, 6 body, 7 engine, 8 TRANSMISSION TYPE, 10 year, 11 plant.
vin_scheme.BMW: WBA/WBS/4US/5UX/WBX: 4-7 AG (type) code = model identification code; 10 year; 11 plant. Transmission is part of the model code only where BMW split it (see answer).
vin_scheme.MINI: WMW: 4-7 type code (RC33 Cooper, RE33 Cooper S, ...), one code per model for both transmissions.
vin_scheme.Volkswagen: 4 series (trim; transmission for some lines MY2006+), 5 engine, 6 restraint, 7-8 model, 10 year, 11 plant.
vin_scheme.Audi: 4 series (with a Trans column MY2010+), 5 engine, 6 restraint, 7-8 model, 10 year, 11 plant.
vin_scheme.Volvo: 4 series, 5 body/restraint, 6-7 engine version, 8 emissions (1994-2003) or body (to 1993), 10 year, 11 factory.
vin_scheme.Mercedes-Benz: 4-6/4-7 model (e.g. WF4J C300 sedan), 8 restraint, 10 year, 11 plant.
vin_scheme.Porsche: 4 line/market, 5 body, 6 restraint/engine, 7-8 model type, 10 year, 11 plant.

not_encoded_or_not_ruled.why: VIN does not encode the transmission; no model code is manual-only on the lots in a way EPA confirms.
VIN does not encode the transmission. Manual-only US models (944 Turbo/S2, 911 GT3) are not separable from the model codes filed, or have no lot car.
Position 4 'Trans' column exists from the MY2010 breakdown; vPIC already decodes these and no lot car without transmission info has a manual code, so no rule was written in this pass.
Golf/GTI/Golf R position 4 keeps a transmission split in later breakdowns; vPIC already decodes these. Jetta, Passat NMS, Beetle, Tiguan, Routan, Touareg: not encoded.
JCW type codes for MY2010-2011 were not transcribed (no lot car carries one). The lot's one MY2009 MS93 (vPIC: no trim) is not in BMW's MY2009 table, so it gets no claim.

BMW's Part 565 filings list both codes of each pair ('HE13 or HE23') without naming the transmission, and no BMW serial-range manual after 1990 is in MID. vPIC decodes some of them (e.g. CD43, BG23 automatic; BG13 manual).
Listed in the same filing both as 'Man. Only' (markets 31, 39) and 'Auto Only' (market 31).

validation_method: Every lot car with a rule WMI, a 17-character VIN and a valid check digit is classified. The model year comes from VIN character 10 (the listing year only picks the 30-year cycle and must be within 2 years). A rule fires only when the VIN matches its WMI, years and fixed characters and its decision characters are in its table for that year; other codes get no claim. Ground truth = scraper/manual_detect/ground_truth.jsonl; uniformCell lines are unlabelled (counted separately), speeds-only lines are excluded, the rest are checkable: agree means (truth is manual) == (rule says manual). All VIN-bearing truth comes from vPIC, which NHTSA builds from the same manufacturer data, so agreement is partly circular; the per-car EPA union check (year, make, feed/vPIC model names, vPIC displacement: a manual claim is consistent when EPA lists a manual, an automatic claim when EPA lists a non-manual) and, for sole-offering rules, the EPA rows of the exact model (row ids; every rule year must have rows and all must be the claimed class) are the independent checks. Status: candidate (not counted) when status_flag is set (the code meaning is not the manufacturer's own for those years, or the EPA check cannot run); drop when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 0.995 or an EPA sole-offering check fails; low_sample when < 20 checkable (kept: the code meaning comes from the manufacturer's own VIN document); keep otherwise. newly_confirmed_manual counts lot cars at US yards with no published transmission (vehicle_extras trans empty) that a keep or low_sample rule calls manual; Canadian-yard cars are listed but not counted.

hub_findings.finding: vPIC decodes MY2006 Jetta VINs (WMI 3VW, model 1K) with position 4 A or C as 'Manual/Standard' and D as 'Automatic', and leaves every other Jetta letter blank. That is the Rabbit's scheme (WVW 1K: A/C man. trans., B/D auto. trans). VW's own MY2006 breakdown (ORG10541, Revision 13) lists Jetta position 4 as trims only: A = 2.0T, C = Diesel Special Ed. w/sunroof, D = 2.5 / TDI w/Package 2, and the 2.0T and TDI were sold with both transmissions. The published Manual badges on these cars are therefore not supported by the manufacturer's VIN scheme.
hub_findings.suggested_action: hub decision: treat vPIC transmission for 2006 Jetta (3VW...1K, char 4 A/C/D, model year 6) as a model-level default like VPIC_TRANS_DEFAULT_CELLS (drop the badge) unless an independent source confirms each car
